title: Balochistan Animal Slaughter Control Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Animal Slaughter Control Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT VI OF 2010
ACT VI OF 2010
BALOCHISTAN ANIMAL SLAUGHTER CONTROL
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the West Pakistan Animal
Slaughter Control Act, 1963 (West Pakistan
Act No.111 of 1963)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
20th May, 2010]
No. PAB/Legis:
V(6)/2010. 224, dated 20-5-2010. ---The Balochistan Animal Slaughter Control
(Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 14th May, 2010 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on
19th May, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
West Pakistan Animal Slaughter Control Act, 1963 (West Pakistan Act No.III of
1963), for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.--(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Animal Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act,
2010.
(2) It extends to the whole of Balochistan except the
Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come
into force at once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of W.P. Act III of 1963

ACT VI OF 2010
ACT VI OF 2010
BALOCHISTAN ANIMAL SLAUGHTER CONTROL
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the West Pakistan Animal
Slaughter Control Act, 1963 (West Pakistan
Act No.111 of 1963)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
20th May, 2010]
No. PAB/Legis:
V(6)/2010. 224, dated 20-5-2010. ---The Balochistan Animal Slaughter Control
(Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 14th May, 2010 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on
19th May, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
West Pakistan Animal Slaughter Control Act, 1963 (West Pakistan Act No.III of
1963), for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
2. Amendment of
section 2 of W.P. Act III of 1963.---In
the West Pakistan Animal Slaughter Control Act, 1963 (West Pakistan Act No.III
of 1963), herein after referred as to the said Act, in section 2,---
(a) in clause (a) after the words "Sheep of any
age" a comma and the words ", no less than six months and claves of
Buffalo/Cattle not less than one year" shall be substituted;
(b) in clause (d),
for the words "West Pakistan" the word "Balochistan" shall
be substituted;
(c) in clause (k),
after the word "Sheep" wherever it appears, the sign and word
"/Goat" shall be inserted; and
(d) in clause
(1),--
(i) for the words
"Veterinary Assistant Surgeon", the words "Veterinary
Officer" shall be substituted.
(ii) the words
"or diploma", appeared after the word "degree" ' shall be
omitted; and
(iii) after the
word "College", the sign and word "/University" shall be
inserted.
